  • 日本語名: 保健室の女神～おっぱい教師 伊香保桧の秘密～
  • 英語名: Hokenshitsu no Megami Oppai Kyoushi Ikaho Hinoki no Himitsu

别名

  • Goddess in the Clinic - The Secret of Breasty Dr. Hinoki Ikaho

あらすじ

“Excuse me, miss. May I ask you about something?”

There’s a goddess at my school.

Her name is Dr. Hinoko Ikaho.

She’s utterly gorgeous. I don’t know why she became a doctor when she could have been a famous gravure idol. But I’m glad she did. She makes the clinic feel sexy.

  • 英語名: Bakunyuu Tsuma Tsumagoi Sumireko Ureta Bunny Girl to Hiretsu na Otoko-tachi

别名

  • Sumire & The Brutal Diner Patrons

あらすじ

“Wait! All you… just… just violate me. ONLY ME!”

Sumire had started staffing at the diner, at her husband’s recommendation.

The food was great and the cheerful atmosphere ensured a steady throng of customers.

It was provocative that the waitresses dressed as bunny girls, but Sumire was okay.

item.title: Otonari-san no Yoru no Kao
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Gekikara Koushinryou
  • 発売日: 2013-02-12
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: お隣さんの夜の顔
  • 英語名: Otonari-san no Yoru no Kao

あらすじ

“How much do you know about your neighbor?”

Kirue Kiryu… the breath of fresh air who lives next door.

Yukio (protagonist) and Kirue cross paths daily, but recently they’ve become closer friends.

But Yukio then saw a side of Kirue he shouldn’t have…

Certain circumstances led Yukio to a paid sex house, where he discovered Kirue was working at night.
